They can't jump straight to the end-game build (终局阵容) for a given Hero, and they can't tell whether a video still applies after a balance patch. Patches come about twice a month.\n- **Streamers and invited writers** already have the material (screenshots of lineups and decks, plus an explanation). They have nowhere to publish it as text, organized so a Reader can find it by Hero, Patch or Author.\n- **The streamers who would run a site** are good at managing fan groups but not comfortable with computers. They need a strict line between themselves and invited writers. Nothing reaches the public site until an Admin has reviewed it.\n\n## Solution\n\n**大巴扎攻略站** is a small CMS with an admin console and a static public site.\n\n- Editors write Guides in Markdown. Each Guide has exactly one Hero and one Patch, uploaded screenshots, and a Chinese text plus an optional English text.\n- Editors Submit Guides for review. Admins Publish them, or Return them with Review notes.\n- An Admin clicks **更新网站** (Site build) to regenerate the public site and put it on GitHub Pages.\n- Readers browse Guides by Hero (grouped by Patch, newest first) or by Author. They can switch the whole site between Chinese and English, and they see the Current Patch in the header.\n- Game names (Heroes, Items, Skills and the rest) always appear as the game's Official names, in the Reader's language.\n\n### The 7 required capabilities, for this client\n\n1. **Login.** Admins and Editors sign in with email and password, and sign out. Passwords are hashed with argon2 and never stored or logged in plain text. Deactivated accounts can't log in. An account created by an Admin starts with a temporary password, and on first login the person sets their own password and Display name.\n2. **Two roles.** **Admin** (管理员): a streamer who runs the site, reviews and Publishes everyone's Guides, and manages users, Pages, Tournament items, Game Terms and Patches. **Editor** (编辑): an invited writer who writes their own Guides and Submits them. An Editor can never Publish, Return, see other people's unpublished Guides, or manage users.\n3. **Posts = Guides.** Each Guide has full create, read, update and delete:\n   - **Fields:** a title and a Markdown body per language, a slug, a Hero, a Patch, a status (Draft / Submitted / Published), the Author, and timestamps.\n   - **Changing a Published Guide:** goes through a Revision, so the live Guide stays up until the change is approved.\n   - **Deleting:** sends the Guide to the Trash.\n4. **Pages.** Admins write Pages (About 关于) with the same fields minus Hero and Patch. Published Pages appear in the public navigation. Tournament announcements and recaps are a small Admin-only list under the 锦标赛 menu.\n5. **Admin console.** A role-aware dashboard with counts (待审核, Returned, my Drafts, changes not yet on the site) and a content list filterable by status, Hero, Author, Patch and language. The Markdown editor has a preview that shows the Guide as Readers will see it, with warnings for unknown Game Terms and nicknames.\n6. **User management (Admin only).** A Users page where Admins can:\n   - create accounts and change roles,\n   - apply or lift a Submission ban,\n   - deactivate or reactivate accounts,\n   - reset passwords.\n\n   Deactivated users can't log in. Admins can't deactivate or demote themselves, and the last active Admin can never be removed.\n7. **Public site and Site build.**\n   - Only Published content is written, with Markdown sanitized.\n   - The navigation is 攻略 and 锦标赛 plus the Published Pages.\n   - The site is built as Chinese and English versions with relative paths only.\n   - The Site build (`cms publish` plus deploy, or the 更新网站 button) is the only step that changes what Readers see.\n\n## User Stories\n\n### Accounts and login\n\n1. As an Admin, I want to sign in with my email and password, so that only I can use my Admin powers.\n2. As an Editor, I want to sign in with my email and password, so that I can work on my Guides.\n3. As an Admin or Editor, I want to sign out, so that nobody else at this computer can act as me.\n4. As an Admin, I want passwords stored only as argon2 hashes, so that a leaked database doesn't leak anyone's password.\n5. As a new Editor, I want to set my own password on first login, so that the temporary password the Admin chose stops working.\n6. As a new Editor, I want to choose my own Display name (my Bilibili name) on first login, so that Readers recognize me.\n7. As an Editor, I want to change my Display name later in my profile, so that I can follow a rename on Bilibili.\n8. As an Author, I want my Display name to be unique on the site, so that Readers never confuse me with another writer.\n9. As an Author, I want my login email never shown on the public site, so that strangers can't use it to try to log in as me.\n10. As a Deactivated user, I want a clear \"account deactivated\" message when I try to log in, so that I know to contact an Admin rather than retry.\n11. As an Admin, I want every form that changes something to carry a CSRF token, so that a malicious link can't act on my behalf.\n\n### Writing Guides\n\n12. As an Editor, I want to create a Guide with a Chinese title and Markdown body, so that I can turn my PowerPoint into a readable text.\n13. As an Editor, I want to optionally add an English title and body, so that English-speaking players can read my Guide too.\n14. As an Editor, I want to pick the Hero from a list of Official names, so that my Guide lands under the right Hero and never under a nickname.\n15. As an Editor, I want to pick the Patch from a list showing `6.7（当前版本）` and the two Patches before it, with the Current Patch preselected, so that I don't have to type or guess the version.\n16. As an Editor, I want to save a Draft and come back later, so that I can write a long Guide over several sittings.\n17. As an Editor, I want to upload screenshots of lineups and decks into my Guide, so that the pictures from my PowerPoint go straight into the text.\n18. As an Editor, I want to give each image an optional short description (alt text), so that Readers using screen readers, or whose images fail to load, still know what the picture shows.\n19. As an Editor, I want to choose which uploaded image is the Guide's cover, defaulting to the first, so that my Guide looks right in the lists.\n20. As an Editor, I want to use one uploaded image in both my Chinese and my English text, so that I don't upload it twice.\n21. As an Editor, I want to mark a Game Term in my text as `[[瓦妮莎]]` or `[[Vanessa]]`, so that it shows as the Official name in whichever language the Reader is using.\n22. As an Editor, I want the preview to warn me about a `[[…]]` that matches no Game Term, so that I can fix typos before an Admin sees them.\n23. As an Editor, I want the preview to warn me when I've used a known nickname (such as 瓦姐) unmarked, so that I can replace it with the Official name.\n24. As an Editor, I want the preview to show my Guide as Readers will see it, so that I know the screenshots and layout come out right.\n25. As an Editor, I want to Submit (提交审核) a finished Guide, so that it goes to the Admins' review queue.\n26. As an Editor, I want to be stopped from Submitting a Guide with no Chinese text, so that I don't send something that can't be Published.\n27. As an Editor, I want the Submit button never to be labelled 发布, so that I'm not misled into thinking my Guide is live.\n28. As an Editor, I want to see only my own Guides in the console, so that the list is about my work.\n29. As an Editor, I want to edit my own Draft and Submitted Guides, so that I can fix something I noticed after Submitting.\n\n### Review\n\n30. As an Admin, I want a 待审核 count and queue on my dashboard, so that I never forget Guides waiting for me.\n31. As an Admin, I want to read a Submitted Guide in the same preview Readers will get, so that I review exactly what would be Published.\n32. As an Admin, I want to Publish a Submitted Guide, so that it goes on the site at the next Site build.\n33. As an Admin, I want to Return a Submitted Guide with one or more Review notes, each quoting a passage and giving advice, so that the Editor knows exactly what to fix and why.\n34. As an Editor, I want a badge on my dashboard when a Guide is Returned, so that I notice it without checking every Guide.\n35. As an Editor, I want to see the Review notes at the top of my Returned Draft, with quoted passages that are still in the text highlighted in the preview, so that I can find each problem quickly.\n36. As an Editor, I want to fix a Returned Guide and Submit it again, so that it can still be Published.\n37. As an Admin, I want earlier Review notes kept with the Guide, so that I can see its history if it goes back and forth.\n38. As an Admin, I want to fix small things myself and Publish directly, so that a typo doesn't cost a full round trip.\n39. As an Admin, I want to change any Guide's Hero, so that I can fix a Guide filed under the wrong Hero.\n40. As an Admin, I want to write and Publish my own Guides without review, so that streamers who run the site aren't slowed down.\n\n### Revisions, Unpublish, deletion\n\n41. As an Editor, I want to open a Revision on my Published Guide, so that I can update it for a new Patch while the old version stays on the site.\n42. As an Editor, I want to save a Revision as a Draft and Submit it later, so that a big update can take several sittings.\n43. As an Editor, I want my Revision to be able to change the Patch, so that a 6.7 Guide updated for 6.8 moves to the 6.8 group on its Hero's page.\n44. As an Editor, I want an approved Revision to replace the old content completely, so that Readers only ever see the current version.\n45. As an Admin, I want to Publish or Return a Revision just like a new Guide, so that review works the same either way.\n46. As an Editor, I want a Returned Revision to leave my live Guide untouched, so that a rejected update never takes my Guide down.\n47. As an Editor, I want at most one open Revision per Guide, so that there's never confusion about which change is pending.\n48. As an Admin, I want my own edits to a Published Guide to take effect immediately, so that I don't have to review myself.\n49. As a Reader, I want to see when a Guide was last updated (更新于), so that I can judge how fresh it is.\n50. As an Admin, I want to Unpublish (撤下) a Guide with an optional Review note, so that I can take down a misleading Guide without destroying the Author's work.\n51. As an Editor, I want an Unpublished Guide to come back to me as a Draft, so that I can fix it and Submit again.\n52. As an Editor, I want to delete my own Guides, including Published ones, so that I stay in control of my work.\n53. As an Editor, I want a confirmation before deleting, so that a misclick doesn't remove a Guide.\n54. As an Admin, I want deleted Guides to go to a Trash only Admins can see, so that an accidental deletion can be undone.\n55. As an Admin, I want to restore a Guide from the Trash, so that it returns to its Author in the state it was in.\n56. As an Admin, I want to delete a Guide from the Trash for good, together with its images, so that the Trash doesn't grow forever.\n57. As an Admin, I want any Guide in the Trash never to appear on the site, so that deleting a Guide always takes it down at the next Site build.\n\n### Game Terms and Patches\n\n58. As an Admin, I want to manage Game Terms of seven kinds (Hero, Item, Skill, Enchantment, Monster, Merchant, Event), each with its official Chinese and English name, so that the site always uses Official names.\n59. As an Admin, I want to import Game Terms from a CSV file, so that thousands of Items and Skills don't have to be typed by hand.\n60. As an Admin, I want CSV rows missing either Official name rejected with a clear per-row message, so that half-filled terms never get in.\n61. As an Admin, I want to see what an import will add or change before it is saved, so that a bad CSV doesn't corrupt the term list.\n62. As an Admin, I want to record known nicknames against a Game Term, so that the editor preview can warn Editors who use them.\n63. As an Admin, I want each Hero to have a URL slug derived from its English Official name, so that Hero pages have clean addresses.\n64. As an Admin, I want to add a new Patch, which becomes the Current Patch, so that a balance patch takes one action on my side.\n65. As a Reader, I want the Current Patch shown in the site header, so that I can compare it with each Guide's Patch myself.\n66. As a Reader, I want no automatic \"outdated\" labels, so that a Guide written for 6.6 that is still valid isn't wrongly flagged.\n\n### Pages and Tournaments\n\n67. As an Admin, I want to write an About (关于) Page with a Chinese and an optional English version, so that Readers know who runs the site and how to contact us.\n68. As an Admin, I want Published Pages to appear in the public navigation automatically, so that I don't have to edit menus by hand.\n69. As an Admin, I want to post a Tournament announcement with the Tournament's date, Patch and optional cover, so that Readers learn about an upcoming in-game Tournament.\n70. As an Admin, I want to post a Tournament recap as its own item, optionally linked to its announcement, so that past Tournaments stay on record.\n71. As a Reader, I want the 锦标赛 section to list announcements and recaps newest first, each badged 预告 or 回顾, so that I can tell at a glance what each item is.\n\n\nT01: Admins and Editors sign in and out\n\nLogin by email and password, with argon2 hashes, server-side sessions held\nin a signed cookie, and an app-wide CSRF check on every POST. Wrong\npasswords and unknown emails get the same refusal and take the same time.\nDeactivated accounts are refused, and so are their open sessions.\n\nFirst-login setup makes a person with a temporary password choose a new\npassword and a unique Display name before they reach any other console\npage. The console gets its Chinese shell: a nav bar, flash messages, and\na dashboard at /admin/dashboard that greets by Display name. /admin stays\nthe T00 hello page.\n\nscripts/seed_demo.py creates one Admin and one Editor from\nCMS_ADMIN_PASSWORD and CMS_EDITOR_PASSWORD, and refuses to run without\nthem. Each test gets its own database through CMS_DATABASE, and\nclient_as() now submits the login form's CSRF token.\n\nCloses #2\n\nCo-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>","stderr":"","interrupted":false,"isImage":false,"noOutputExpected":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"14352e9f-b064-439e-8a21-a2b92d3b3b1d","permissionDecision":{"decision":"accept","source":"config","reasonType":"mode"},"session_id":"d96011e5-3b71-4963-9a6a-32eb66e9ffdb","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/yining/orca/workspaces/iphs400-mp2-cms/IPHS400-Mini-Project-2","sessionId":"d96011e5-3b71-4963-9a6a-32eb66e9ffdb","version":"2.1.302","gitBranch":"Avulpix0412/IPHS400-Mini-Project-2"}

{"parentUuid":"b57429b2-61f0-4cf5-9dd7-581d30979024","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"db0ce52a-1c7b-48d6-875f-d1d127354d44","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_013a4Tg3zzAvxBZkeLZwatJu","type":"tool_result","content":"=== app/db.py\n\"\"\"SQLite storage. The database lives at CMS_DATABASE and is never committed.\n\nThe schema is created on connect (every statement is IF NOT EXISTS), so a fresh\nclone and a fresh test database need no separate setup step.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport sqlite3\nfrom collections.abc import Iterator\nfrom contextlib import contextmanager\n\nfrom app import settings\n\nSCHEMA = \"\"\"\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS users (\n    id            INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,\n    email         TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE COLLATE NOCASE,\n    password_hash TEXT NOT NULL,\n    role          TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (role IN ('admin', 'editor')),\n    display_name  TEXT UNIQUE COLLATE NOCASE,\n    state         TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active'\n                  CHECK (state IN ('active', 'submission_ban', 'deactivated')),\n    needs_setup   INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,\n    created_at    TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n);\n\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sessions (\n    id         TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\n    user_id    INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n);\n\"\"\"\n\n\n@contextmanager\ndef connect() -> Iterator[sqlite3.Connection]:\n    \"\"\"Open the database, commit if the block succeeds, and always close.\"\"\"\n    conn = sqlite3.connect(settings.database_path())\n    conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row\n    conn.execute(\"PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON\")\n    try:\n        conn.executescript(SCHEMA)\n        yield conn\n        conn.commit()\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n=== app/web.py\n\"\"\"Console plumbing shared by every route: templates, the signed session\ncookie, CSRF tokens, flash messages, and the signed-in guard.\n\nThe session cookie (Starlette's SessionMiddleware, signed with itsdangerous\nusing CMS_SECRET_KEY) holds only three things: the session id, the CSRF token,\nand pending flash messages. Who is signed in is decided by the `sessions`\ntable, never by the cookie alone.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport secrets\n\nfrom fastapi import Request\nfrom fastapi.responses import PlainTextResponse, RedirectResponse\nfrom fastapi.templating import Jinja2Templates\n\nfrom app import accounts, db, settings\n\nSESSION_COOKIE = \"cms_session\"\nSESSION_MAX_AGE = 12 * 60 * 60  # seconds; sign in again after half a day\n\ntemplates = Jinja2Templates(directory=str(settings.TEMPLATES))\n\n\ndef csrf_token(request: Request) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The token every console form carries as a hidden `csrf_token` field.\"\"\"\n    token = request.session.get(\"csrf\")\n    if not token:\n        token = request.session[\"csrf\"] = secrets.token_urlsafe(32)\n    return token\n\n\nSAFE_METHODS = {\"GET\", \"HEAD\", \"OPTIONS\"}\n\n\nclass CsrfRejected(Exception):\n    \"\"\"A state-changing request whose form lacks this session's token.\"\"\"\n\n\nasync def verify_csrf(request: Request) -> None:\n    \"\"\"App-wide dependency: every POST (or other unsafe method) must carry the\n    session's CSRF token in its form, or it is refused before the route runs.\"\"\"\n    if request.method in SAFE_METHODS:\n        return\n    expected = request.session.get(\"csrf\")\n    sent = (await request.form()).get(\"csrf_token\")\n    if not expected or not isinstance(sent, str) or not secrets.compare_digest(sent, expected):\n        raise CsrfRejected\n\n\nasync def csrf_rejected_handler(request: Request, exc: Exception) -> PlainTextResponse:\n    return PlainTextResponse(\"请求已过期或来源不明，请返回刷新页面后重试。\",\n                             status_code=403)\n\n\ndef flash(request: Request, message: str, kind: str = \"success\") -> None:\n    \"\"\"Queue a message for the next page shown. kind: success | error.\"\"\"\n    request.session.setdefault(\"flash\", []).append([kind, message])\n\n\ndef pop_flashes(request: Request) -> list[list[str]]:\n    return request.session.pop(\"flash\", [])\n\n\ntemplates.env.globals[\"csrf_token\"] = csrf_token\ntemplates.env.globals[\"pop_flashes\"] = pop_flashes\n\n\ndef start_session(request: Request, session_id: str) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Replace the cookie's contents, so nothing from before login survives\n    (the CSRF token is reissued on the next page).\"\"\"\n    request.session.clear()\n    request.session[\"sid\"] = session_id\n\n\nclass LoginRequired(Exception):\n    \"\"\"Raised when nobody is signed in; answered with a redirect to /login.\"\"\"\n\n\nclass SetupRequired(Exception):\n    \"\"\"Raised when the user still has first-login setup to do; answered with a\n    redirect to /admin/setup.\"\"\"\n\n\ndef signed_in_user_mid_setup(request: Request) -> accounts.User:\n    \"\"\"Dependency for the setup page only: the signed-in user, whether or not\n    they have finished first-login setup.\"\"\"\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        user = accounts.user_for_session(conn, request.session.get(\"sid\"))\n    if user is None:\n        raise LoginRequired\n    return user\n\n\ndef signed_in_user(request: Request) -> accounts.User:\n    \"\"\"Dependency for every other console page: the signed-in user, who has\n    finished first-login setup. Anyone else is redirected.\"\"\"\n    user = signed_in_user_mid_setup(request)\n    if user.needs_setup:\n        raise SetupRequired\n    return user\n\n\ndef home_for(user: accounts.User) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Where a signed-in user belongs: setup first, then the dashboard.\"\"\"\n    return \"/admin/setup\" if user.needs_setup else \"/admin/dashboard\"\n\n\ndef redirect(url: str) -> RedirectResponse:\n    return RedirectResponse(url, status_code=303)\n\n\nasync def login_required_handler(request: Request, exc: Exception) -> RedirectResponse:\n    return redirect(\"/login\")\n\n\nasync def setup_required_handler(request: Request, exc: Exception) -> RedirectResponse:\n    return redirect(\"/admin/setup\")\n=== app/accounts.py\n\"\"\"Accounts: users, password hashing, login and logout, and sessions.\n\nPasswords are only ever stored as argon2 hashes and never logged. A session is\na random id kept in the `sessions` table; the browser holds it inside a signed\ncookie (see app/web.py), so logging out deletes the row and ends the session\neven if someone kept a copy of the cookie.\n\nAnything the console should refuse raises `Refused` with a message to show.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport secrets\nimport sqlite3\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass\n\nfrom argon2 import PasswordHasher\nfrom argon2.exceptions import VerifyMismatchError\n\n_hasher = PasswordHasher()\n# Checked against when the email is unknown, so that a wrong email takes as\n# long to refuse as a wrong password and timing doesn't reveal which exist.\n_DUMMY_HASH = _hasher.hash(secrets.token_urlsafe(16))\n\nBAD_CREDENTIALS = \"邮箱或密码错误。\"\nDISPLAY_NAME_TAKEN = \"该昵称已被使用，请换一个。\"\n\n\nclass Refused(Exception):\n    \"\"\"An account action the console refuses, with the reason to show.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self, message: str) -> None:\n        super().__init__(message)\n        self.message = message\n\n\nclass AccountDeactivated(Refused):\n    \"\"\"The password was right, but the account is Deactivated.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self) -> None:\n        super().__init__(\"账号已停用，无法登录。如有疑问，请联系管理员。\")\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass User:\n    id: int\n    email: str\n    role: str\n    display_name: str | None\n    state: str\n    needs_setup: bool\n\n\ndef _user_from_row(row: sqlite3.Row) -> User:\n    return User(id=row[\"id\"], email=row[\"email\"], role=row[\"role\"],\n                display_name=row[\"display_name\"], state=row[\"state\"],\n                needs_setup=bool(row[\"needs_setup\"]))\n\n\ndef _matches(password_hash: str, password: str) -> bool:\n    try:\n        return _hasher.verify(password_hash, password)\n    except VerifyMismatchError:\n        return False\n\n\ndef _normalise_email(email: str) -> str:\n    return email.strip().lower()\n\n\ndef create_user(conn: sqlite3.Connection, *, email: str, password: str,\n                role: str, display_name: str | None = None,\n                needs_setup: bool = False, state: str = \"active\") -> User:\n    \"\"\"Raises Refused if the email or Display name already belongs to someone.\"\"\"\n    try:\n        cur = conn.execute(\n            \"INSERT INTO users (email, password_hash, role, display_name,\"\n            \" needs_setup, state) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)\",\n            (_normalise_email(email), _hasher.hash(password), role, display_name,\n             int(needs_setup), state),\n        )\n    except sqlite3.IntegrityError as error:\n        if \"users.email\" in str(error):\n            raise Refused(\"该邮箱已有账号。\") from None\n        if \"users.display_name\" in str(error):\n            raise Refused(DISPLAY_NAME_TAKEN) from None\n        raise\n    row = conn.execute(\"SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = ?\", (cur.lastrowid,)).fetchone()\n    return _user_from_row(row)\n\n\ndef log_in(conn: sqlite3.Connection, email: str, password: str) -> tuple[str, User]:\n    \"\"\"Check the credentials and start a session.\n    Returns the session id and the signed-in user.\"\"\"\n    row = conn.execute(\"SELECT * FROM users WHERE email = ?\",\n                       (_normalise_email(email),)).fetchone()\n    # Hash-check first, even for an unknown email, so both take the same time.\n    password_ok = _matches(row[\"password_hash\"] if row else _DUMMY_HASH, password)\n    if row is None or not password_ok:\n        raise Refused(BAD_CREDENTIALS)\n    # Only told after the right password, so the state reveals nothing either.\n    if row[\"state\"] == \"deactivated\":\n        raise AccountDeactivated\n    session_id = secrets.token_urlsafe(32)\n    conn.execute(\"INSERT INTO sessions (id, user_id) VALUES (?, ?)\",\n                 (session_id, row[\"id\"]))\n    return session_id, _user_from_row(row)\n\n\ndef log_out(conn: sqlite3.Connection, session_id: str | None) -> None:\n    conn.execute(\"DELETE FROM sessions WHERE id = ?\", (session_id,))\n\n\nMIN_PASSWORD_LENGTH = 8\nMAX_DISPLAY_NAME_LENGTH = 30\n\n\ndef complete_setup(conn: sqlite3.Connection, user: User, *, display_name: str,\n                   password: str, password_confirm: str) -> None:\n    \"\"\"First-login setup: the user replaces their temporary password and\n    chooses their Display name. Raises Refused if either is unacceptable.\"\"\"\n    display_name = display_name.strip()\n    if not display_name:\n        raise Refused(\"请填写昵称。\")\n    if len(display_name) > MAX_DISPLAY_NAME_LENGTH:\n        raise Refused(f\"昵称最多 {MAX_DISPLAY_NAME_LENGTH} 个字符。\")\n    if display_name.lower() == user.email.lower():\n        raise Refused(\"昵称不能是登录邮箱，昵称会公开显示。\")\n    if len(password) < MIN_PASSWORD_LENGTH:\n        raise Refused(f\"密码至少需要 {MIN_PASSWORD_LENGTH} 个字符。\")\n    if password != password_confirm:\n        raise Refused(\"两次输入的密码不一致。\")\n    current = conn.execute(\"SELECT password_hash FROM users WHERE id = ?\",\n                           (user.id,)).fetchone()\n    if _matches(current[\"password_hash\"], password):\n        raise Refused(\"新密码不能与临时密码相同。\")\n    try:\n        conn.execute(\n            \"UPDATE users SET display_name = ?, password_hash = ?, needs_setup = 0\"\n            \" WHERE id = ?\", (display_name, _hasher.hash(password), user.id))\n    except sqlite3.IntegrityError:\n        raise Refused(DISPLAY_NAME_TAKEN) from None\n\n\ndef set_state(conn: sqlite3.Connection, email: str, state: str) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Put an account into a state: active, submission_ban or deactivated.\n    A Deactivated account's open sessions stop working at once.\"\"\"\n    conn.execute(\"UPDATE users SET state = ? WHERE email = ?\",\n                 (state, _normalise_email(email)))\n\n\ndef user_for_session(conn: sqlite3.Connection, session_id: str | None) -> User | None:\n    \"\"\"The user a session belongs to, or None if the session is gone or the\n    account has been Deactivated since it was opened.\"\"\"\n    if not session_id:\n        return None\n    row = conn.execute(\n        \"SELECT users.* FROM sessions JOIN users ON users.id = sessions.user_id\"\n        \" WHERE sessions.id = ? AND users.state != 'deactivated'\",\n        (session_id,)).fetchone()\n    return _user_from_row(row) if row else None\n=== app/main.py\n\"\"\"The FastAPI application.\n\nT00: the admin console answers at /admin and the public site answers at /.\nTicket routes live in their own modules under app/routes/ and are included\nhere. Keep this file small.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom fastapi import Depends, FastAPI, Request\nfrom starlette.middleware.sessions import SessionMiddleware\n\nfrom app import settings, web\nfrom app.routes import auth, dashboard\nfrom app.web import templates\n\n\ndef create_app() -> FastAPI:\n    app = FastAPI(title=\"IPHS 400 MP2 CMS\",\n                  dependencies=[Depends(web.verify_csrf)])\n    app.add_middleware(SessionMiddleware, secret_key=settings.SECRET_KEY,\n                       session_cookie=web.SESSION_COOKIE,\n                       max_age=web.SESSION_MAX_AGE, same_site=\"lax\")\n    app.add_exception_handler(web.LoginRequired, web.login_required_handler)\n    app.add_exception_handler(web.SetupRequired, web.setup_required_handler)\n    app.add_exception_handler(web.CsrfRejected, web.csrf_rejected_handler)\n\n    @app.get(\"/admin\")\n    def admin_home(request: Request):\n        return templates.TemplateResponse(\n            request, \"admin/hello.html\", {\"title\": \"Admin\"}\n        )\n\n    @app.get(\"/\")\n    def public_home(request: Request):\n        return templates.TemplateResponse(\n            request, \"public/home.html\",\n            {\"title\": settings.SITE_TITLE, \"items\": []},\n        )\n\n    app.include_router(auth.router)\n    app.include_router(dashboard.router)\n    return app\n\n\napp = create_app()\n=== app/settings.py\n\"\"\"Configuration, read from the environment (never hard-code secrets).\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport os\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]\nTEMPLATES = ROOT / \"templates\"\nSITE = ROOT / \"site\"\n\nSECRET_KEY = os.environ.get(\"CMS_SECRET_KEY\", \"dev-only-not-for-production\")\nSITE_TITLE = os.environ.get(\"CMS_SITE_TITLE\", \"My CMS\")\n# Set this to your Pages URL once you deploy, e.g.\n# https://yourname.github.io/iphs400-mp2-cms/\nBASE_PATH = os.environ.get(\"CMS_BASE_PATH\", \"\")\n\n\ndef database_path() -> Path:\n    \"\"\"Read on every connect, so tests can point CMS_DATABASE at a temp file.\"\"\"\n    return Path(os.environ.get(\"CMS_DATABASE\", ROOT / \"cms.db\"))\n=== app/routes/__init__.py\n=== app/routes/auth.py\n\"\"\"Login, logout, and first-login setup.\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom typing import Annotated\n\nfrom fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, Form, Request\n\nfrom app import accounts, db\nfrom app.accounts import User\nfrom app.web import (flash, home_for, redirect, signed_in_user_mid_setup,\n                     start_session, templates)\n\nrouter = APIRouter()\n\n\n@router.get(\"/login\")\ndef login_form(request: Request):\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(request, \"admin/login.html\",\n                                      {\"title\": \"登录\", \"email\": \"\"})\n\n\n@router.post(\"/login\")\ndef login(request: Request, email: Annotated[str, Form()],\n          password: Annotated[str, Form()]):\n    try:\n        with db.connect() as conn:\n            session_id, user = accounts.log_in(conn, email, password)\n    except accounts.Refused as refused:\n        return templates.TemplateResponse(\n            request, \"admin/login.html\",\n            {\"title\": \"登录\", \"email\": email, \"error\": refused.message},\n            status_code=403 if isinstance(refused, accounts.AccountDeactivated)\n            else 401)\n    start_session(request, session_id)\n    return redirect(home_for(user))\n\n\n@router.post(\"/logout\")\ndef logout(request: Request):\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        accounts.log_out(conn, request.session.get(\"sid\"))\n    request.session.clear()\n    flash(request, \"已退出登录。\")\n    return redirect(\"/login\")\n\n\n@router.get(\"/admin/setup\")\ndef setup_form(request: Request,\n               user: Annotated[User, Depends(signed_in_user_mid_setup)]):\n    if not user.needs_setup:\n        return redirect(home_for(user))\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n        request, \"admin/setup.html\",\n        {\"title\": \"首次登录设置\", \"user\": user, \"display_name\": \"\"})\n\n\n@router.post(\"/admin/setup\")\ndef setup(request: Request,\n          user: Annotated[User, Depends(signed_in_user_mid_setup)],\n          display_name: Annotated[str, Form()], password: Annotated[str, Form()],\n          password_confirm: Annotated[str, Form()]):\n    if not user.needs_setup:\n        return redirect(home_for(user))\n    try:\n        with db.connect() as conn:\n            accounts.complete_setup(conn, user, display_name=display_name,\n                                    password=password,\n                                    password_confirm=password_confirm)\n    except accounts.Refused as refused:\n        return templates.TemplateResponse(\n            request, \"admin/setup.html\",\n            {\"title\": \"首次登录设置\", \"user\": user, \"display_name\": display_name,\n             \"error\": refused.message},\n            status_code=400)\n    flash(request, \"设置完成，欢迎加入！\")\n    return redirect(\"/admin/dashboard\")\n=== app/routes/dashboard.py\n\"\"\"The console dashboard. /admin itself stays the T00 hello page.\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom typing import Annotated\n\nfrom fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, Request\n\nfrom app.accounts import User\nfrom app.web import signed_in_user, templates\n\nrouter = APIRouter()\n\n\n@router.get(\"/admin/dashboard\")\ndef dashboard(request: Request, user: Annotated[User, Depends(signed_in_user)]):\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(request, \"admin/dashboard.html\",\n                                      {\"title\": \"控制台\", \"user\": user})\n=== app/cli.py\n\"\"\"The `cms` command: serve, publish, deploy.\n\n    uv run cms serve      # admin console + public preview at http://localhost:8000\n    uv run cms publish    # render site/ from published content\n    uv run cms deploy     # push site/ to the gh-pages branch (Pages serves Later tickets add\ndemo Heroes, Patches, Game Terms, Guides, a Page and Tournament items.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport os\nimport sys\n\nfrom app import accounts, db, settings\n\n# Matches DEMO_USERS in tests/conftest.py (which uses its own fixed passwords).\nDEMO_USERS = [\n    # role, email, Display name, environment variable holding the password\n    (\"admin\", \"admin@example.test\", \"演示管理员\", \"CMS_ADMIN_PASSWORD\"),\n    (\"editor\", \"editor@example.test\", \"演示编辑\", \"CMS_EDITOR_PASSWORD\"),\n]\n\n\ndef main() -> int:\n    missing = [var for *_, var in DEMO_USERS if not os.environ.get(var)]\n    if missing:\n        print(f\"Set {' and '.join(missing)} in .env (copy .env.example), then run \"\n              \"`uv run --env-file .env python scripts/seed_demo.py`.\")\n        return 1\n\n    for *_, var in DEMO_USERS:\n        if os.environ[var].startswith(\"change-me\"):\n            print(f\"Warning: {var} is still the .env.example placeholder. \"\n                  \"Change it in .env before anyone else can reach this console.\")\n\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        for role, email, display_name, var in DEMO_USERS:\n            try:\n                accounts.create_user(conn, email=email, password=os.environ[var],\n                                     role=role, display_name=display_name)\n            except accounts.Refused:\n                print(f\"{role}: {email} already exists, left unchanged.\")\n                continue\n            print(f\"{role}: created {email} (password from {var}).\")\n    print(f\"Database: {settings.database_path()}\")\n    return 0\n\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    sys.exit(main())","is_error":false}]},"uuid":"717febb0-0c46-45aa-a6fd-58322d46f9d7","timestamp":"2026-10-17T12:02:56.938Z","toolUseResult":{"stdout":"=== app/db.py\n\"\"\"SQLite storage. The database lives at CMS_DATABASE and is never committed.\n\nThe schema is created on connect (every statement is IF NOT EXISTS), so a fresh\nclone and a fresh test database need no separate setup step.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport sqlite3\nfrom collections.abc import Iterator\nfrom contextlib import contextmanager\n\nfrom app import settings\n\nSCHEMA = \"\"\"\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS users (\n    id            INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,\n    email         TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE COLLATE NOCASE,\n    password_hash TEXT NOT NULL,\n    role          TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (role IN ('admin', 'editor')),\n    display_name  TEXT UNIQUE COLLATE NOCASE,\n    state         TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active'\n                  CHECK (state IN ('active', 'submission_ban', 'deactivated')),\n    needs_setup   INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,\n    created_at    TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n);\n\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sessions (\n    id         TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\n    user_id    INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n);\n\"\"\"\n\n\n@contextmanager\ndef connect() -> Iterator[sqlite3.Connection]:\n    \"\"\"Open the database, commit if the block succeeds, and always close.\"\"\"\n    conn = sqlite3.connect(settings.database_path())\n    conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row\n    conn.execute(\"PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON\")\n    try:\n        conn.executescript(SCHEMA)\n        yield conn\n        conn.commit()\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n=== app/web.py\n\"\"\"Console plumbing shared by every route: templates, the signed session\ncookie, CSRF tokens, flash messages, and the signed-in guard.\n\nThe session cookie (Starlette's SessionMiddleware, signed with itsdangerous\nusing CMS_SECRET_KEY) holds only three things: the session id, the CSRF token,\nand pending flash messages. Who is signed in is decided by the `sessions`\ntable, never by the cookie alone.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport secrets\n\nfrom fastapi import Request\nfrom fastapi.responses import PlainTextResponse, RedirectResponse\nfrom fastapi.templating import Jinja2Templates\n\nfrom app import accounts, db, settings\n\nSESSION_COOKIE = \"cms_session\"\nSESSION_MAX_AGE = 12 * 60 * 60  # seconds; sign in again after half a day\n\ntemplates = Jinja2Templates(directory=str(settings.TEMPLATES))\n\n\ndef csrf_token(request: Request) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The token every console form carries as a hidden `csrf_token` field.\"\"\"\n    token = request.session.get(\"csrf\")\n    if not token:\n        token = request.session[\"csrf\"] = secrets.token_urlsafe(32)\n    return token\n\n\nSAFE_METHODS = {\"GET\", \"HEAD\", \"OPTIONS\"}\n\n\nclass CsrfRejected(Exception):\n    \"\"\"A state-changing request whose form lacks this session's token.\"\"\"\n\n\nasync def verify_csrf(request: Request) -> None:\n    \"\"\"App-wide dependency: every POST (or other unsafe method) must carry the\n    session's CSRF token in its form, or it is refused before the route runs.\"\"\"\n    if request.method in SAFE_METHODS:\n        return\n    expected = request.session.get(\"csrf\")\n    sent = (await request.form()).get(\"csrf_token\")\n    if not expected or not isinstance(sent, str) or not secrets.compare_digest(sent, expected):\n        raise CsrfRejected\n\n\nasync def csrf_rejected_handler(request: Request, exc: Exception) -> PlainTextResponse:\n    return PlainTextResponse(\"请求已过期或来源不明，请返回刷新页面后重试。\",\n                             status_code=403)\n\n\ndef flash(request: Request, message: str, kind: str = \"success\") -> None:\n    \"\"\"Queue a message for the next page shown. kind: success | error.\"\"\"\n    request.session.setdefault(\"flash\", []).append([kind, message])\n\n\ndef pop_flashes(request: Request) -> list[list[str]]:\n    return request.session.pop(\"flash\", [])\n\n\ntemplates.env.globals[\"csrf_token\"] = csrf_token\ntemplates.env.globals[\"pop_flashes\"] = pop_flashes\n\n\ndef start_session(request: Request, session_id: str) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Replace the cookie's contents, so nothing from before login survives\n    (the CSRF token is reissued on the next page).\"\"\"\n    request.session.clear()\n    request.session[\"sid\"] = session_id\n\n\nclass LoginRequired(Exception):\n    \"\"\"Raised when nobody is signed in; answered with a redirect to /login.\"\"\"\n\n\nclass SetupRequired(Exception):\n    \"\"\"Raised when the user still has first-login setup to do; answered with a\n    redirect to /admin/setup.\"\"\"\n\n\ndef signed_in_user_mid_setup(request: Request) -> accounts.User:\n    \"\"\"Dependency for the setup page only: the signed-in user, whether or not\n    they have finished first-login setup.\"\"\"\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        user = accounts.user_for_session(conn, request.session.get(\"sid\"))\n    if user is None:\n        raise LoginRequired\n    return user\n\n\ndef signed_in_user(request: Request) -> accounts.User:\n    \"\"\"Dependency for every other console page: the signed-in user, who has\n    finished first-login setup. Anyone else is redirected.\"\"\"\n    user = signed_in_user_mid_setup(request)\n    if user.needs_setup:\n        raise SetupRequired\n    return user\n\n\ndef home_for(user: accounts.User) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Where a signed-in user belongs: setup first, then the dashboard.\"\"\"\n    return \"/admin/setup\" if user.needs_setup else \"/admin/dashboard\"\n\n\ndef redirect(url: str) -> RedirectResponse:\n    return RedirectResponse(url, status_code=303)\n\n\nasync def login_required_handler(request: Request, exc: Exception) -> RedirectResponse:\n    return redirect(\"/login\")\n\n\nasync def setup_required_handler(request: Request, exc: Exception) -> RedirectResponse:\n    return redirect(\"/admin/setup\")\n=== app/accounts.py\n\"\"\"Accounts: users, password hashing, login and logout, and sessions.\n\nPasswords are only ever stored as argon2 hashes and never logged. A session is\na random id kept in the `sessions` table; the browser holds it inside a signed\ncookie (see app/web.py), so logging out deletes the row and ends the session\neven if someone kept a copy of the cookie.\n\nAnything the console should refuse raises `Refused` with a message to show.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport secrets\nimport sqlite3\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass\n\nfrom argon2 import PasswordHasher\nfrom argon2.exceptions import VerifyMismatchError\n\n_hasher = PasswordHasher()\n# Checked against when the email is unknown, so that a wrong email takes as\n# long to refuse as a wrong password and timing doesn't reveal which exist.\n_DUMMY_HASH = _hasher.hash(secrets.token_urlsafe(16))\n\nBAD_CREDENTIALS = \"邮箱或密码错误。\"\nDISPLAY_NAME_TAKEN = \"该昵称已被使用，请换一个。\"\n\n\nclass Refused(Exception):\n    \"\"\"An account action the console refuses, with the reason to show.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self, message: str) -> None:\n        super().__init__(message)\n        self.message = message\n\n\nclass AccountDeactivated(Refused):\n    \"\"\"The password was right, but the account is Deactivated.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self) -> None:\n        super().__init__(\"账号已停用，无法登录。如有疑问，请联系管理员。\")\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass User:\n    id: int\n    email: str\n    role: str\n    display_name: str | None\n    state: str\n    needs_setup: bool\n\n\ndef _user_from_row(row: sqlite3.Row) -> User:\n    return User(id=row[\"id\"], email=row[\"email\"], role=row[\"role\"],\n                display_name=row[\"display_name\"], state=row[\"state\"],\n                needs_setup=bool(row[\"needs_setup\"]))\n\n\ndef _matches(password_hash: str, password: str) -> bool:\n    try:\n        return _hasher.verify(password_hash, password)\n    except VerifyMismatchError:\n        return False\n\n\ndef _normalise_email(email: str) -> str:\n    return email.strip().lower()\n\n\ndef create_user(conn: sqlite3.Connection, *, email: str, password: str,\n                role: str, display_name: str | None = None,\n                needs_setup: bool = False, state: str = \"active\") -> User:\n    \"\"\"Raises Refused if the email or Display name already belongs to someone.\"\"\"\n    try:\n        cur = conn.execute(\n            \"INSERT INTO users (email, password_hash, role, display_name,\"\n            \" needs_setup, state) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)\",\n            (_normalise_email(email), _hasher.hash(password), role, display_name,\n             int(needs_setup), state),\n        )\n    except sqlite3.IntegrityError as error:\n        if \"users.email\" in str(error):\n            raise Refused(\"该邮箱已有账号。\") from None\n        if \"users.display_name\" in str(error):\n            raise Refused(DISPLAY_NAME_TAKEN) from None\n        raise\n    row = conn.execute(\"SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = ?\", (cur.lastrowid,)).fetchone()\n    return _user_from_row(row)\n\n\ndef log_in(conn: sqlite3.Connection, email: str, password: str) -> tuple[str, User]:\n    \"\"\"Check the credentials and start a session.\n    Returns the session id and the signed-in user.\"\"\"\n    row = conn.execute(\"SELECT * FROM users WHERE email = ?\",\n                       (_normalise_email(email),)).fetchone()\n    # Hash-check first, even for an unknown email, so both take the same time.\n    password_ok = _matches(row[\"password_hash\"] if row else _DUMMY_HASH, password)\n    if row is None or not password_ok:\n        raise Refused(BAD_CREDENTIALS)\n    # Only told after the right password, so the state reveals nothing either.\n    if row[\"state\"] == \"deactivated\":\n        raise AccountDeactivated\n    session_id = secrets.token_urlsafe(32)\n    conn.execute(\"INSERT INTO sessions (id, user_id) VALUES (?, ?)\",\n                 (session_id, row[\"id\"]))\n    return session_id, _user_from_row(row)\n\n\ndef log_out(conn: sqlite3.Connection, session_id: str | None) -> None:\n    conn.execute(\"DELETE FROM sessions WHERE id = ?\", (session_id,))\n\n\nMIN_PASSWORD_LENGTH = 8\nMAX_DISPLAY_NAME_LENGTH = 30\n\n\ndef complete_setup(conn: sqlite3.Connection, user: User, *, display_name: str,\n                   password: str, password_confirm: str) -> None:\n    \"\"\"First-login setup: the user replaces their temporary password and\n    chooses their Display name. Raises Refused if either is unacceptable.\"\"\"\n    display_name = display_name.strip()\n    if not display_name:\n        raise Refused(\"请填写昵称。\")\n    if len(display_name) > MAX_DISPLAY_NAME_LENGTH:\n        raise Refused(f\"昵称最多 {MAX_DISPLAY_NAME_LENGTH} 个字符。\")\n    if display_name.lower() == user.email.lower():\n        raise Refused(\"昵称不能是登录邮箱，昵称会公开显示。\")\n    if len(password) < MIN_PASSWORD_LENGTH:\n        raise Refused(f\"密码至少需要 {MIN_PASSWORD_LENGTH} 个字符。\")\n    if password != password_confirm:\n        raise Refused(\"两次输入的密码不一致。\")\n    current = conn.execute(\"SELECT password_hash FROM users WHERE id = ?\",\n                           (user.id,)).fetchone()\n    if _matches(current[\"password_hash\"], password):\n        raise Refused(\"新密码不能与临时密码相同。\")\n    try:\n        conn.execute(\n            \"UPDATE users SET display_name = ?, password_hash = ?, needs_setup = 0\"\n            \" WHERE id = ?\", (display_name, _hasher.hash(password), user.id))\n    except sqlite3.IntegrityError:\n        raise Refused(DISPLAY_NAME_TAKEN) from None\n\n\ndef set_state(conn: sqlite3.Connection, email: str, state: str) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Put an account into a state: active, submission_ban or deactivated.\n    A Deactivated account's open sessions stop working at once.\"\"\"\n    conn.execute(\"UPDATE users SET state = ? WHERE email = ?\",\n                 (state, _normalise_email(email)))\n\n\ndef user_for_session(conn: sqlite3.Connection, session_id: str | None) -> User | None:\n    \"\"\"The user a session belongs to, or None if the session is gone or the\n    account has been Deactivated since it was opened.\"\"\"\n    if not session_id:\n        return None\n    row = conn.execute(\n        \"SELECT users.* FROM sessions JOIN users ON users.id = sessions.user_id\"\n        \" WHERE sessions.id = ? AND users.state != 'deactivated'\",\n        (session_id,)).fetchone()\n    return _user_from_row(row) if row else None\n=== app/main.py\n\"\"\"The FastAPI application.\n\nT00: the admin console answers at /admin and the public site answers at /.\nTicket routes live in their own modules under app/routes/ and are included\nhere. Keep this file small.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom fastapi import Depends, FastAPI, Request\nfrom starlette.middleware.sessions import SessionMiddleware\n\nfrom app import settings, web\nfrom app.routes import auth, dashboard\nfrom app.web import templates\n\n\ndef create_app() -> FastAPI:\n    app = FastAPI(title=\"IPHS 400 MP2 CMS\",\n                  dependencies=[Depends(web.verify_csrf)])\n    app.add_middleware(SessionMiddleware, secret_key=settings.SECRET_KEY,\n                       session_cookie=web.SESSION_COOKIE,\n                       max_age=web.SESSION_MAX_AGE, same_site=\"lax\")\n    app.add_exception_handler(web.LoginRequired, web.login_required_handler)\n    app.add_exception_handler(web.SetupRequired, web.setup_required_handler)\n    app.add_exception_handler(web.CsrfRejected, web.csrf_rejected_handler)\n\n    @app.get(\"/admin\")\n    def admin_home(request: Request):\n        return templates.TemplateResponse(\n            request, \"public/home.html\",\n            {\"title\": settings.SITE_TITLE, \"items\": []},\n        )\n\n    app.include_router(auth.router)\n    app.include_router(dashboard.router)\n    return app\n\n\napp = create_app()\n=== app/settings.py\n\"\"\"Configuration, read from the environment (never hard-code secrets).\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ os.environ.get(\"CMS_SECRET_KEY\", \"dev-only-not-for-production\")\nSITE_TITLE = os.environ.get(\"CMS_SITE_TITLE\", \"My CMS\")\n# Set this to your Pages URL once you deploy, e.g.\n# it)\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport argparse\nimport subprocess\nimport sys\n\nfrom app import settings\nfrom app.publish import render_site\n\n\ndef main(argv: list[str] | None Later tickets add\ndemo Heroes, Patches, Game Terms, Guides, a Page and Tournament items.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport os\nimport sys\n\nfrom app import accounts, db, settings\n\n# Matches DEMO_USERS in tests/conftest.py (which uses its own fixed passwords).\nDEMO_USERS = [\n    # role, email, Display name, environment variable holding the password\n    (\"admin\", \"admin@example.test\", \"演示管理员\", \"CMS_ADMIN_PASSWORD\"),\n    (\"editor\", \"editor@example.test\", \"演示编辑\", \"CMS_EDITOR_PASSWORD\"),\n]\n\n\ndef main() -> int:\n    missing = [var for *_, var in DEMO_USERS if not os.environ.get(var)]\n    if missing:\n        print(f\"Set {' and '.join(missing)} in .env (copy .env.example), then run \"\n              \"`uv run --env-file .env python scripts/seed_demo.py`.\")\n        return 1\n\n    for *_, var in DEMO_USERS:\n        if os.environ[var].startswith(\"change-me\"):\n            print(f\"Warning: {var} is still the .env.example placeholder. \"\n                  \"Change it in .env before anyone else can reach this console.\")\n\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        for role, email, display_name, var in DEMO_USERS:\n            try:\n                accounts.create_user(conn, email=email, password=os.environ[var],\n                                     role=role, display_name=display_name)\n            except accounts.Refused:\n                print(f\"{role}: {email} already exists, left unchanged.\")\n                continue\n            print(f\"{role}: created {email} (password from {var}).\")\n    print(f\"Database: {settings.database_path()}\")\n    return 0\n\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    sys.exit(main())","stderr":"","interrupted":false,"isImage":false,"noOutputExpected":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"b57429b2-61f0-4cf5-9dd7-581d30979024","permissionDecision":{"decision":"accept","source":"config","reasonType":"mode"},"session_id":"d96011e5-3b71-4963-9a6a-32eb66e9ffdb","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/yining/orca/workspaces/iphs400-mp2-cms/IPHS400-Mini-Project-2","sessionId":"d96011e5-3b71-4963-9a6a-32eb66e9ffdb","version":"2.1.302","gitBranch":"Avulpix0412/IPHS400-Mini-Project-2"}

{"type":"api-request-blob","sessionId":"d96011e5-3b71-4963-9a6a-32eb66e9ffdb","hash":"ef8685708396ad123c58a3456ed3f47896005f1aa4dae48103664ff631b1ef8e","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_013a4Tg3zzAvxBZkeLZwatJu","type":"tool_result","content":"=== app/db.py\n\"\"\"SQLite storage. The database lives at CMS_DATABASE and is never committed.\n\nThe schema is created on connect (every statement is IF NOT EXISTS), so a fresh\nclone and a fresh test database need no separate setup step.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport sqlite3\nfrom collections.abc import Iterator\nfrom contextlib import contextmanager\n\nfrom app import settings\n\nSCHEMA = \"\"\"\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS users (\n    id            INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,\n    email         TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE COLLATE NOCASE,\n    password_hash TEXT NOT NULL,\n    role          TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (role IN ('admin', 'editor')),\n    display_name  TEXT UNIQUE COLLATE NOCASE,\n    state         TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active'\n                  CHECK (state IN ('active', 'submission_ban', 'deactivated')),\n    needs_setup   INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,\n    created_at    TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n);\n\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sessions (\n    id         TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\n    user_id    INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n);\n\"\"\"\n\n\n@contextmanager\ndef connect() -> Iterator[sqlite3.Connection]:\n    \"\"\"Open the database, commit if the block succeeds, and always close.\"\"\"\n    conn = sqlite3.connect(settings.database_path())\n    conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row\n    conn.execute(\"PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON\")\n    try:\n        conn.executescript(SCHEMA)\n        yield conn\n        conn.commit()\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n=== app/web.py\n\"\"\"Console plumbing shared by every route: templates, the signed session\ncookie, CSRF tokens, flash messages, and the signed-in guard.\n\nThe session cookie (Starlette's SessionMiddleware, signed with itsdangerous\nusing CMS_SECRET_KEY) holds only three things: the session id, the CSRF token,\nand pending flash messages. Who is signed in is decided by the `sessions`\ntable, never by the cookie alone.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport secrets\n\nfrom fastapi import Request\nfrom fastapi.responses import PlainTextResponse, RedirectResponse\nfrom fastapi.templating import Jinja2Templates\n\nfrom app import accounts, db, settings\n\nSESSION_COOKIE = \"cms_session\"\nSESSION_MAX_AGE = 12 * 60 * 60  # seconds; sign in again after half a day\n\ntemplates = Jinja2Templates(directory=str(settings.TEMPLATES))\n\n\ndef csrf_token(request: Request) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The token every console form carries as a hidden `csrf_token` field.\"\"\"\n    token = request.session.get(\"csrf\")\n    if not token:\n        token = request.session[\"csrf\"] = secrets.token_urlsafe(32)\n    return token\n\n\nSAFE_METHODS = {\"GET\", \"HEAD\", \"OPTIONS\"}\n\n\nclass CsrfRejected(Exception):\n    \"\"\"A state-changing request whose form lacks this session's token.\"\"\"\n\n\nasync def verify_csrf(request: Request) -> None:\n    \"\"\"App-wide dependency: every POST (or other unsafe method) must carry the\n    session's CSRF token in its form, or it is refused before the route runs.\"\"\"\n    if request.method in SAFE_METHODS:\n        return\n    expected = request.session.get(\"csrf\")\n    sent = (await request.form()).get(\"csrf_token\")\n    if not expected or not isinstance(sent, str) or not secrets.compare_digest(sent, expected):\n        raise CsrfRejected\n\n\nasync def csrf_rejected_handler(request: Request, exc: Exception) -> PlainTextResponse:\n    return PlainTextResponse(\"请求已过期或来源不明，请返回刷新页面后重试。\",\n                             status_code=403)\n\n\ndef flash(request: Request, message: str, kind: str = \"success\") -> None:\n    \"\"\"Queue a message for the next page shown. kind: success | error.\"\"\"\n    request.session.setdefault(\"flash\", []).append([kind, message])\n\n\ndef pop_flashes(request: Request) -> list[list[str]]:\n    return request.session.pop(\"flash\", [])\n\n\ntemplates.env.globals[\"csrf_token\"] = csrf_token\ntemplates.env.globals[\"pop_flashes\"] = pop_flashes\n\n\ndef start_session(request: Request, session_id: str) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Replace the cookie's contents, so nothing from before login survives\n    (the CSRF token is reissued on the next page).\"\"\"\n    request.session.clear()\n    request.session[\"sid\"] = session_id\n\n\nclass LoginRequired(Exception):\n    \"\"\"Raised when nobody is signed in; answered with a redirect to /login.\"\"\"\n\n\nclass SetupRequired(Exception):\n    \"\"\"Raised when the user still has first-login setup to do; answered with a\n    redirect to /admin/setup.\"\"\"\n\n\ndef signed_in_user_mid_setup(request: Request) -> accounts.User:\n    \"\"\"Dependency for the setup page only: the signed-in user, whether or not\n    they have finished first-login setup.\"\"\"\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        user = accounts.user_for_session(conn, request.session.get(\"sid\"))\n    if user is None:\n        raise LoginRequired\n    return user\n\n\ndef signed_in_user(request: Request) -> accounts.User:\n    \"\"\"Dependency for every other console page: the signed-in user, who has\n    finished first-login setup. Anyone else is redirected.\"\"\"\n    user = signed_in_user_mid_setup(request)\n    if user.needs_setup:\n        raise SetupRequired\n    return user\n\n\ndef home_for(user: accounts.User) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Where a signed-in user belongs: setup first, then the dashboard.\"\"\"\n    return \"/admin/setup\" if user.needs_setup else \"/admin/dashboard\"\n\n\ndef redirect(url: str) -> RedirectResponse:\n    return RedirectResponse(url, status_code=303)\n\n\nasync def login_required_handler(request: Request, exc: Exception) -> RedirectResponse:\n    return redirect(\"/login\")\n\n\nasync def setup_required_handler(request: Request, exc: Exception) -> RedirectResponse:\n    return redirect(\"/admin/setup\")\n=== app/accounts.py\n\"\"\"Accounts: users, password hashing, login and logout, and sessions.\n\nPasswords are only ever stored as argon2 hashes and never logged. A session is\na random id kept in the `sessions` table; the browser holds it inside a signed\ncookie (see app/web.py), so logging out deletes the row and ends the session\neven if someone kept a copy of the cookie.\n\nAnything the console should refuse raises `Refused` with a message to show.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport secrets\nimport sqlite3\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass\n\nfrom argon2 import PasswordHasher\nfrom argon2.exceptions import VerifyMismatchError\n\n_hasher = PasswordHasher()\n# Checked against when the email is unknown, so that a wrong email takes as\n# long to refuse as a wrong password and timing doesn't reveal which exist.\n_DUMMY_HASH = _hasher.hash(secrets.token_urlsafe(16))\n\nBAD_CREDENTIALS = \"邮箱或密码错误。\"\nDISPLAY_NAME_TAKEN = \"该昵称已被使用，请换一个。\"\n\n\nclass Refused(Exception):\n    \"\"\"An account action the console refuses, with the reason to show.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self, message: str) -> None:\n        super().__init__(message)\n        self.message = message\n\n\nclass AccountDeactivated(Refused):\n    \"\"\"The password was right, but the account is Deactivated.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self) -> None:\n        super().__init__(\"账号已停用，无法登录。如有疑问，请联系管理员。\")\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass User:\n    id: int\n    email: str\n    role: str\n    display_name: str | None\n    state: str\n    needs_setup: bool\n\n\ndef _user_from_row(row: sqlite3.Row) -> User:\n    return User(id=row[\"id\"], email=row[\"email\"], role=row[\"role\"],\n                display_name=row[\"display_name\"], state=row[\"state\"],\n                needs_setup=bool(row[\"needs_setup\"]))\n\n\ndef _matches(password_hash: str, password: str) -> bool:\n    try:\n        return _hasher.verify(password_hash, password)\n    except VerifyMismatchError:\n        return False\n\n\ndef _normalise_email(email: str) -> str:\n    return email.strip().lower()\n\n\ndef create_user(conn: sqlite3.Connection, *, email: str, password: str,\n                role: str, display_name: str | None = None,\n                needs_setup: bool = False, state: str = \"active\") -> User:\n    \"\"\"Raises Refused if the email or Display name already belongs to someone.\"\"\"\n    try:\n        cur = conn.execute(\n            \"INSERT INTO users (email, password_hash, role, display_name,\"\n            \" needs_setup, state) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)\",\n            (_normalise_email(email), _hasher.hash(password), role, display_name,\n             int(needs_setup), state),\n        )\n    except sqlite3.IntegrityError as error:\n        if \"users.email\" in str(error):\n            raise Refused(\"该邮箱已有账号。\") from None\n        if \"users.display_name\" in str(error):\n            raise Refused(DISPLAY_NAME_TAKEN) from None\n        raise\n    row = conn.execute(\"SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = ?\", (cur.lastrowid,)).fetchone()\n    return _user_from_row(row)\n\n\ndef log_in(conn: sqlite3.Connection, email: str, password: str) -> tuple[str, User]:\n    \"\"\"Check the credentials and start a session.\n    Returns the session id and the signed-in user.\"\"\"\n    row = conn.execute(\"SELECT * FROM users WHERE email = ?\",\n                       (_normalise_email(email),)).fetchone()\n    # Hash-check first, even for an unknown email, so both take the same time.\n    password_ok = _matches(row[\"password_hash\"] if row else _DUMMY_HASH, password)\n    if row is None or not password_ok:\n        raise Refused(BAD_CREDENTIALS)\n    # Only told after the right password, so the state reveals nothing either.\n    if row[\"state\"] == \"deactivated\":\n        raise AccountDeactivated\n    session_id = secrets.token_urlsafe(32)\n    conn.execute(\"INSERT INTO sessions (id, user_id) VALUES (?, ?)\",\n                 (session_id, row[\"id\"]))\n    return session_id, _user_from_row(row)\n\n\ndef log_out(conn: sqlite3.Connection, session_id: str | None) -> None:\n    conn.execute(\"DELETE FROM sessions WHERE id = ?\", (session_id,))\n\n\nMIN_PASSWORD_LENGTH = 8\nMAX_DISPLAY_NAME_LENGTH = 30\n\n\ndef complete_setup(conn: sqlite3.Connection, user: User, *, display_name: str,\n                   password: str, password_confirm: str) -> None:\n    \"\"\"First-login setup: the user replaces their temporary password and\n    chooses their Display name. Raises Refused if either is unacceptable.\"\"\"\n    display_name = display_name.strip()\n    if not display_name:\n        raise Refused(\"请填写昵称。\")\n    if len(display_name) > MAX_DISPLAY_NAME_LENGTH:\n        raise Refused(f\"昵称最多 {MAX_DISPLAY_NAME_LENGTH} 个字符。\")\n    if display_name.lower() == user.email.lower():\n        raise Refused(\"昵称不能是登录邮箱，昵称会公开显示。\")\n    if len(password) < MIN_PASSWORD_LENGTH:\n        raise Refused(f\"密码至少需要 {MIN_PASSWORD_LENGTH} 个字符。\")\n    if password != password_confirm:\n        raise Refused(\"两次输入的密码不一致。\")\n    current = conn.execute(\"SELECT password_hash FROM users WHERE id = ?\",\n                           (user.id,)).fetchone()\n    if _matches(current[\"password_hash\"], password):\n        raise Refused(\"新密码不能与临时密码相同。\")\n    try:\n        conn.execute(\n            \"UPDATE users SET display_name = ?, password_hash = ?, needs_setup = 0\"\n            \" WHERE id = ?\", (display_name, _hasher.hash(password), user.id))\n    except sqlite3.IntegrityError:\n        raise Refused(DISPLAY_NAME_TAKEN) from None\n\n\ndef set_state(conn: sqlite3.Connection, email: str, state: str) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Put an account into a state: active, submission_ban or deactivated.\n    A Deactivated account's open sessions stop working at once.\"\"\"\n    conn.execute(\"UPDATE users SET state = ? WHERE email = ?\",\n                 (state, _normalise_email(email)))\n\n\ndef user_for_session(conn: sqlite3.Connection, session_id: str | None) -> User | None:\n    \"\"\"The user a session belongs to, or None if the session is gone or the\n    account has been Deactivated since it was opened.\"\"\"\n    if not session_id:\n        return None\n    row = conn.execute(\n        \"SELECT users.* FROM sessions JOIN users ON users.id = sessions.user_id\"\n        \" WHERE sessions.id = ? AND users.state != 'deactivated'\",\n        (session_id,)).fetchone()\n    return _user_from_row(row) if row else None\n=== app/main.py\n\"\"\"The FastAPI application.\n\nT00: the admin console answers at /admin and the public site answers at /.\nTicket routes live in their own modules under app/routes/ and are included\nhere. Keep this file small.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom fastapi import Depends, FastAPI, Request\nfrom starlette.middleware.sessions import SessionMiddleware\n\nfrom app import settings, web\nfrom app.routes import auth, dashboard\nfrom app.web import templates\n\n\ndef create_app() -> FastAPI:\n    app = FastAPI(title=\"IPHS 400 MP2 CMS\",\n                  dependencies=[Depends(web.verify_csrf)])\n    app.add_middleware(SessionMiddleware, secret_key=settings.SECRET_KEY,\n                       session_cookie=web.SESSION_COOKIE,\n                       max_age=web.SESSION_MAX_AGE, same_site=\"lax\")\n    app.add_exception_handler(web.LoginRequired, web.login_required_handler)\n    app.add_exception_handler(web.SetupRequired, web.setup_required_handler)\n    app.add_exception_handler(web.CsrfRejected, web.csrf_rejected_handler)\n\n    @app.get(\"/admin\")\n    def admin_home(request: Request):\n        return templates.TemplateResponse(\n            request, \"admin/hello.html\", {\"title\": \"Admin\"}\n        )\n\n    @app.get(\"/\")\n    def public_home(request: Request):\n        return templates.TemplateResponse(\n            request, \"public/home.html\",\n            {\"title\": settings.SITE_TITLE, \"items\": []},\n        )\n\n    app.include_router(auth.router)\n    app.include_router(dashboard.router)\n    return app\n\n\napp = create_app()\n=== app/settings.py\n\"\"\"Configuration, read from the environment (never hard-code secrets).\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport os\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]\nTEMPLATES = ROOT / \"templates\"\nSITE = ROOT / \"site\"\n\nSECRET_KEY = os.environ.get(\"CMS_SECRET_KEY\", \"dev-only-not-for-production\")\nSITE_TITLE = os.environ.get(\"CMS_SITE_TITLE\", \"My CMS\")\n# Set this to your Pages URL once you deploy, e.g.\n# https://yourname.github.io/iphs400-mp2-cms/\nBASE_PATH = os.environ.get(\"CMS_BASE_PATH\", \"\")\n\n\ndef database_path() -> Path:\n    \"\"\"Read on every connect, so tests can point CMS_DATABASE at a temp file.\"\"\"\n    return Path(os.environ.get(\"CMS_DATABASE\", ROOT / \"cms.db\"))\n=== app/routes/__init__.py\n=== app/routes/auth.py\n\"\"\"Login, logout, and first-login setup.\"\"\"\nfrom it)\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport argparse\nimport subprocess\nimport sys\n\nfrom app import settings\nfrom app.publish import render_site\n\n\ndef main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:\n    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog=\"cms\")\n    sub = parser.add_subparsers(dest=\"command\", required=True)\n    serve = sub.add_parser(\"serve\", help=\"run the admin console locally\")\n    serve.add_argument(\"--port\", type=int, default=8000)\n    serve.add_argument(\"--reload\", action=\"store_true\", default=True)\n    sub.add_parser(\"publish\", help=\"render site/ from published content\")\n    deploy = sub.add_parser(\"deploy\", help=\"push site/ to gh-pages\")\n    deploy.add_argument(\"--message\", default=\"Publish site\")\n    args = parser.parse_args(argv)\n\n    if args.command == \"serve\":\n        import uvicorn\n\n        uvicorn.run(\"app.main:app\", port=args.port, reload=args.reload)\n        return 0\n\n    if args.command == \"publish\":\n        out = render_site()\n        print(f\"Wrote {out}. DEMO_USERS if not os.environ.get(var)]\n    if missing:\n        print(f\"Set {' and '.join(missing)} in .env (copy .env.example), then run \"\n              \"`uv run --env-file .env python scripts/seed_demo.py`.\")\n        return 1\n\n    for *_, var in DEMO_USERS:\n        if os.environ[var].startswith(\"change-me\"):\n            print(f\"Warning: {var} is still the .env.example placeholder. \"\n                  \"Change it in .env before anyone else can reach this console.\")\n\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        for role, email, display_name, var in DEMO_USERS:\n accounts.Refused:\n                print(f\"{role}: {email} already exists, left unchanged.\")\n                continue\n            print(f\"{role}: created {email} (password from {var}).\")\n    print(f\"Database: {settings.database_path()}\")\n    return 0\n\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n (through `CMS_DATABASE`) holding\nonly the DEMO_USERS below.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\n\nimport pytest\nfrom fastapi.testclient import TestClient\n\nfrom app.main import create_app\n\n# Matches scripts/seed_demo.py. Passwords come from the environment there; in\n# tests they are fixed and meaningless.\nDEMO_USERS = {\n    \"admin\": {\"email\": \"admin@example.test\", \"password\": \"test-admin-pw\",\n \"演示编辑\"},\n}\n\n\n@pytest.fixture(autouse=True)\ndef database(tmp_path, monkeypatch):\n    \"\"\"A fresh database per test, seeded with DEMO_USERS.\"\"\"\n    from app import accounts, db\n\n    monkeypatch.setenv(\"CMS_DATABASE\", str(tmp_path / \"cms.db\"))\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        for role, user in DEMO_USERS.items():\n            accounts.create_user(conn, \"cms.db\"\n\n\ndef add_user(**fields) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Arrange an extra account (until the Users page exists to make one).\"\"\"\n    from app import accounts, db\n\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        accounts.create_user(conn, **fields)\n\n\ndef csrf_token(page_html: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Pull the CSRF token out of a rendered console form.\"\"\"\n    match = re.search(r'name=\"csrf_token\" value=\"([^\"]+)\"', page_html)\n    assert match, \"page has no CSRF token\"\n    return match.group(1)\n\n\ndef login(c: TestClient, email: str, password: str):\n Students have two weeks and no\nhosting budget, and a first web application with real authentication is an\nattractive target the moment it is public.\n\n## Decision\n\nThe admin console (FastAPI + SQLite) runs on the student's own machine. A\n`cms publish` step renders the published content to static HTML in `site/`, which\nis deployed to GitHub Pages on the `gh-pages` branch.\n\n## Consequences\n\n- Login, roles, and the database are never exposed to the internet.\n- The public site cannot have server-side features (search, comments) without a\n  different host; a stretch goal may add a live admin deploy behind a security gate.\n- Publishing is explicit: content changes are not live until `cms publish` runs,\n  which is a behaviour worth documenting for your client.\n- Relative paths become mandatory, because Pages serves the site from a subfolder.\n\n## Why this is an ADR\n\nIt is hard to reverse (it shapes every route, template, and deploy step) and it\nis surprising without context (most CMSes are servers). That is the bar; most\ndecisions do not meet it and belong in the spec or the glossary instead.\n# ADR-002: FastAPI + Jinja + SQLite, with no frontend framework\n\n**Status:** accepted (set by the assignment)\n**Date:** 2026-09-22\n\n## Context\n\nThe project has to be readable by someone who has never built a web application,\ngradable from a clean clone, and finishable in two weeks on a $20 plan. A\n`cms publish` step renders the published content to static HTML in `site/`, which\nis deployed to GitHub Pages on the `gh-pages` branch.\n\n## Consequences\n\n- Login, roles, and the database are never exposed to the internet.\n- The public site cannot have server-side features (search, comments) without a\n  different host; a stretch goal may add a live admin deploy behind a security gate.\n- Publishing is explicit: content changes are not live until `cms publish` runs,\n  which is a behaviour worth documenting for your client.\n- Relative paths become mandatory, because Pages serves the site from a subfolder.\n\n## Why this is an ADR\n\nIt is hard to reverse (it shapes every route, template, and deploy step) and it\nis surprising without context (most CMSes are servers). That is the bar; most\ndecisions do not meet it and belong in the spec or the glossary instead.\n# ADR-002: FastAPI + Jinja + SQLite, with no frontend framework\n\n**Status:** accepted (set by the assignment)\n**Date:** 2026-09-22\n\n## Context\n\nThe project has to be readable by someone who has never built a web application,\ngradable from a clean clone, and finishable in two weeks on a $20 plan. Options\nconsidered: Django (batteries included, but a large amount of generated code to\nread), Flask (similar to FastAPI here), a JavaScript stack (a second language and\na build step), and FastAPI with server-rendered templates.\n\n## Decision\n\nFastAPI with Jinja2 templates, SQLite for storage, argon2 for password hashing,\nand an HTML sanitizer for user Markdown. No frontend framework, no build step.\n\n## Consequences\n\n- Every page is server-rendered, so \"view source\" shows what the code produced,\n  which makes debugging visible.\n- SQLite is a single file, so a grader can seed and inspect it easily. It is\n  gitignored; `scripts/seed_demo.py` rebuilds it.\n- No build step means the file you preview is the file that ships.\n- Interactive flourishes (live preview without reload, drag-and-drop) cost more\n  here than in a JavaScript stack. {"type":"api-request-blob","sessionId":"d96011e5-3b71-4963-9a6a-32eb66e9ffdb","hash":"21e0a13ea41e924968f69ece6c6b5c94adaeb3d5064b75a18d5f694530360614","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"type":"tool_result","tool_use_id":"toolu_0197jJBfDkFPNrM21xbZRmN9","content":"Launching skill: mattpocock-skills:tdd"},{"type":"text","text":"Base directory for this skill: /Users/yining/.claude/plugins/cache/claude-plugins-official/mattpocock-skills/1.3.1/skills/engineering/tdd\n\n# Test-Driven Development\n\nTDD is the red → green loop. This skill is the reference that makes that loop produce tests worth keeping: what a good test is, where tests go, the anti-patterns, and the rules of the loop. Every section applies on every cycle: consult them before and during the loop, not after.\n\nWhen exploring the codebase, read `GLOSSARY.md` (if it exists) so test names and interface vocabulary match the project's domain language, and respect ADRs in the area you're touching.\n\n## What a good test is\n\nTests verify behavior through public interfaces, not implementation details. Code can change entirely; tests shouldn't. A good test reads like a specification: \"user can checkout with valid cart\" tells you exactly what capability exists, and it survives refactors because it doesn't care about internal structure.\n\nSee [tests.md](tests.md) for examples and [mocking.md](mocking.md) for mocking guidelines.\n\n## Seams: where tests go\n\nA **seam** is the public boundary you test at: the interface where you observe behavior without reaching inside. Tests live at seams, never against internals.\n\n**Test only at pre-agreed seams.** Before writing any test, write down the seams under test and confirm them with the user. No test is written at an unconfirmed seam. You can't test everything, so agreeing the seams up front is how testing effort lands on the critical paths and complex logic instead of every edge case.\n\nAsk: \"What's the public interface, and which seams should we test?\" Give each proposed seam a one-line note on what it catches and what it misses.\n\nWhen the shape of that interface is itself in question (how deep the module is, where the seam belongs, what the interface should expose), call the Skill tool with \"codebase-design\" for the vocabulary. It is the shared source of the module, interface, depth, seam, adapter, leverage and locality terms, and it is a reference to consult, not a session to run.\n\n## Anti-patterns\n\n- **Implementation-coupled**: mocks internal collaborators, tests private methods, or verifies through a side channel (querying the database instead of using the interface). The tell: the test breaks when you refactor but behavior hasn't changed.\n- **Tautological**: the assertion recomputes the expected value the way the code does (`expect(add(a, b)).toBe(a + b)`, a snapshot derived by hand the same way, a constant asserted equal to itself), so it passes by construction and can never disagree with the code. Expected values must come from an independent source of truth: a known-good literal, a worked example, the spec.\n- **Horizontal slicing**: writing all tests first, then all implementation. Bulk tests verify _imagined_ behavior: you test the _shape_ of things rather than user-facing behavior, the tests go insensitive to real changes, and you commit to test structure before understanding the implementation. Work in **vertical slices** instead: one test → one implementation → repeat, each test a **tracer bullet** that responds to what the last cycle taught you.\n\n## Rules of the loop\n\n- **Red before green.** Write the failing test first, then only enough code to pass it. Don't anticipate future tests or add speculative features.\n- **One slice at a time.** One seam, one test, one minimal implementation per cycle.\n- **Refactoring is not part of the loop.** It belongs to the review stage (see the `code-review` skill), not the red → green implementation cycle.\n\n\nARGUMENTS: T02 — Admins manage Heroes and Patches, tested at the HTTP console seam"}]}}

Admins manage Heroes and Patches (Seam 1: the console over HTTP).\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom fastapi.testclient import TestClient\n\nfrom conftest import csrf_token\n\n\ndef submit(c: TestClient, form_page: str, action: str, **fields):\n    \"\"\"Fill in the form on `form_page` the way a browser does, token included.\"\"\"\n    token = csrf_token(c.get(form_page).text)\n    return c.post(action, data={\"csrf_token\": token, **fields},\n                  follow_redirects=False)\n\n\ndef add_hero(c: TestClient, name_zh: str, name_en: str):\n    return submit(c, \"/admin/heroes\", \"/admin/heroes\",\n                  name_zh=name_zh, name_en=name_en)\n\n\ndef test_admin_adds_a_hero_and_sees_it_listed_with_its_slug(client_as):\n    admin =
